page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 104 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance runs on a KVM hypervisor and does not utilize hyperthreading, providing dedicated compute resources per vCPU.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core. A key feature of this server configuration is its bundled local storage, which consists of 23,038 GB of solid-state drive capacity. This high-density local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i3.26xlarge provides high resource density, particularly in terms of local SSD storage and dedicated CPU cores. This makes it suitable for workloads requiring high-capacity, low-latency local storage alongside substantial memory and compute resources. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, data warehousing, big data analytics, and storage-intensive enterprise applications.
